name: shared-workspace-registry
goal: The registry and graph show the hosted Web workspace consuming the same workspace shell as the Electron and iOS workspace, with every other uncertainty kept

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Root saw Workspace shell Relationships name only the Electron and iOS root. HostedWorkspace.svelte imports the same shell, store and routes through the hub's $desktop alias; the index takes each for an outside package, so the registry has no edge and no consumer. Reproduced by test/shared-workspace-registry.test.ts on the real registry

steps.title: Write and run a failing regression test that faithfully reproduces the defect; record proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged tree 775ce2e, test sha b3c336cd: 4 failed. The index resolves none of the three alias imports; the shell's consumers are desktop.page.root alone; a change of the shell reaches neither the hosted workspace nor its page; no declaration exists for that file. work/shared-workspace-modes/red/registry-red.log

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Declare the three alias imports of HostedWorkspace.svelte as references with their owned target files, the mechanism harness.units.json already supports, and re-index. Guard: a test on this repository's own index, registry, impact analysis and uncertainty list. No alias engine, no external rule

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: harness.units.json gains three references with targets; re-indexing changed one manifest, the hosted workspace, by three derived dependencies. Titles and declared responsibilities on five assigned manifests; ids, ownership, contracts and budgets unchanged. No runtime, style or product source change. test/shared-workspace-registry.test.ts runs in the root unit suite

steps.title: Repeat repair and the same unchanged regression test until it passes; record passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same test, sha b3c336cd: 4 passed on the mapping alone and again after the descriptions (work/shared-workspace-modes/green). units check valid, 37 uncertain references as before; explain check 5 reasons; scenarios check valid. Existing index, graph and uncertainty tests with it: 30 passed in 7 files. units show names both consumers of the shell

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Throwaway copy with its own scratch repository; unmutated 4 passed. All three references removed: 4 failed. One removed: 2 failed. Shell declared external: 3 failed. Shell sent to another file: 3 failed. References removed with links written by hand: 4 failed. units check called each stale (work/shared-workspace-modes/mutants). Copy removed

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and keep pending while proof fails.
